SESSION 2 SUMMARY (resumed run).

LANDED ON MAIN (10 changes / 9 tickets): e63c(1459), d064(1460), 176d(1461), e63c-docstring(1467), c9c6(1464), 2d1c(1466), 7504(1471), da31(1465), 2e16(1468), 8537(1469).

CLOSED: e63c, d064, c9c6, 2d1c (+ others still running the completion verifier).
NOT STARTED (15): 0743 1de3 373f fc0c 3803 47e9 f0ff 4b94 4fc1 9ce8 ab77 ad16 da4c 8a31 8efe.

METHOD: all leaves after the first three used held-out TDD with implementer subagents in isolated worktrees; I authored and ran the validation oracles and mutation-tested every one. Mutations killed tests in every case.

HARD-WON OPERATIONAL LESSONS (for the next run):
1. GENERATED FILES: src/rebar/types.py, docs/cli-reference.md, docs/mcp-reference.md, docs/env-vars.md are generated; hand-editing any is a CI drift-gate failure. Regenerate. Cost one Verified-1.
2. bugfix-size-attestation: a BUG fix over 150 non-test lines needs a plan-review attestation even though bugs are exempt from the CLAIM gate. Cost three LLM-Review-1s (da31, 2e16, 8537). Earn the attestation BEFORE first push on any non-trivial bug.
3. Re-pushing an amended commit with an IDENTICAL tree is NO_CODE_CHANGE: Gerrit COPIES the old votes forward and the bot never re-runs. Use the repo's  comment trigger (review_bot/retrigger.py TRIGGER_TOKEN) instead.
4. Attestations pin a base SHA and go stale when main advances -- including from your own merges. Run review-plan and claim back-to-back in ONE shot.
5. Worktree venvs: NEVER symlink a sibling worktree's .venv. It is an editable install pointing at THAT worktree's src, so pytest silently tests the wrong tree. Build a real venv per worktree.
6. Plan-review BLOCKs in this epic were ALL real (723f x3, ae96 x2, 7be3 x4) -- consistently under-enumerated edit sets, especially symbols/filenames referenced AS STRINGS in guard tuples that read_text() the path. Two blocks were on MY OWN remediation text.
7. Known pre-existing failure, not ours: tests/unit/metrics/test_jscpd_dup_heldout.py::test_live_clone (host jscpd min-tokens > fixture size).
